post.description:
Import a pending glossary batch. Members cannot seed aliases.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request with backend settings.
    body: Source, version, idempotency key, and entries.
    caller: Authenticated caller context.

Returns:
    Import identifiers. Duplicate idempotency keys reuse one row.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403 for members/viewers, 400 for validation failures,
        503 when the database URL is unset.

Approve a pending import and project aliases into search_aliases.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request with backend settings.
    import_id: Pending import identifier.
    caller: Authenticated caller context.

Returns:
    Updated import identifiers.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403 for members/viewers, 400 when approval is rejected.

Roll back an approved import by deleting its search projection.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request with backend settings.
    import_id: Import identifier.
    caller: Authenticated caller context.

Returns:
    Updated import identifiers.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403 for members/viewers, 400 when rollback is rejected.

get.description:
List curated and suggested entity rules. Members receive 403.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request with backend settings.
    caller: Authenticated caller context.

Returns:
    Rule listing. Native LightRAG names are not copied into Hybrid aliases.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403 for members/viewers, 503 when unconfigured.

post.description:
Create an approved admin rule or a typed draft. Members receive 403.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request with backend settings.
    body: Rule payload. Feedback/model sources cannot be auto-approved.
    caller: Authenticated caller context.

Returns:
    Mutation identifiers. Approved writes schedule rebuild isolation.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403 for members/viewers, 400 for validation.

Store an inactive feedback/model suggestion. Never auto-approves.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request with backend settings.
    body: Suggestion payload with provenance/confidence.
    caller: Authenticated caller context.

Returns:
    Identifiers with ``invalidated=false``.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403 for members/viewers, 400 for validation.

patch.description:
Update one rule with optimistic concurrency. Members receive 403.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request with backend settings.
    rule_id: Existing rule identifier.
    body: Updated payload including ``row_version``.
    caller: Authenticated caller context.

Returns:
    Mutation identifiers.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403, 409 for stale versions, 400 for validation.

post.description:
Explicitly approve a suggestion and schedule a clean rebuild.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request with backend settings.
    rule_id: Suggestion identifier.
    body: Expected ``row_version``.
    caller: Authenticated caller context.

Returns:
    Mutation identifiers with invalidation/rebuild job ids.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403, 409, or 400.

Revoke a rule. Approved revocations invalidate maps.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request with backend settings.
    rule_id: Rule identifier.
    body: Expected ``row_version``.
    caller: Authenticated caller context.

Returns:
    Mutation identifiers.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403, 409, or 400.

Inspect authorized graph objects. Members and viewers are ACL-filtered.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request with backend settings.
    body: Seed entity keys and/or document id, depth at most 3.
    caller: Authenticated caller context.

Returns:
    At most 200 rows and canonical locators. Native prose is omitted.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 401 via identity dependency, 400 for seed/deadline,
        503 when the database URL is unset.

get.description:
Call the registered liveness behavior for direct smoke tests.

Returns:
    A mapping with ``status=live``.

Call the honest unconfigured readiness behavior for direct smoke tests.

Returns:
    A mapping with ``status=unconfigured``.

post.description:
Enqueue one approved website crawl. Members cannot broaden crawl scope.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request with backend settings.
    body: Start URL, approved domain, and crawl bounds.
    caller: Authenticated caller context.

Returns:
    Document/source/job identifiers. Duplicate idempotency keys reuse one job.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403 for members/viewers, 400 for policy/domain mismatch,
        503 when the database URL is unset.

Retry one failed, backoff, or dead-letter ingestion job when authorized.

Dead-letter replay creates a **new** job with a new idempotency key and
retains the original dead-letter row. Failed-but-not-dead-letter jobs only
clear ``next_attempt_at``; ``last_error`` and ``attempt_count`` stay.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request with backend settings.
    job_id: Source ingestion job identifier.
    caller: Authenticated caller context.

Returns:
    The job that should run next (replay child for dead-letter).

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403 for members/viewers, 404 when missing, 409 when the
        job is not retryable, 503 when the database URL is unset.

get.description:
Return public lifecycle and nested diagnostics for one document version.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request with backend settings.
    version_id: Canonical document version identifier.
    caller: Authenticated caller; role controls ``retry_allowed`` only.

Returns:
    Version status plus recent job summaries.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the version is missing; 503 when the database
        URL is unset.
